call_id.description: the telephony session id; one grade per call, ever

recording.description: a recording URL the module can fetch once; audio is transcribed and discarded, never stored

direction.description: KPIs count inbound only; outbound is graded for coaching and set aside

duration_sec.description: from the phone system, never from the model; feeds the three-minute lost-lead rule

store.description: the location code as the buyer names it

answered_by.description: extension or person as the phone system names it; blank or shared lines group as Unassigned

standard.description: the name and version of the rubric.yaml this call is graded against; absent means the module refuses (Rung 0)
